questions.question_text: What is a common example of AI that teens use every day, as mentioned in the chapter?

options.text: A graphing calculator for math homework
Siri or Google Assistant for voice commands and reminders
A paper dictionary for looking up words
A traditional alarm clock for waking upCorrect Answer: B) Siri or Google Assistant for voice commands and reminders

questions.question_text: According to the chapter, how can AI help high school students with their writing assignments?

options.text: It writes complete essays without any student input
It checks grammar, suggests better word choices, and improves sentence structure
It blocks access to writing resources to prevent cheating
It only works for math and science assignmentsCorrect Answer: B) It checks grammar, suggests better word choices, and improves sentence structure

questions.question_text: Which AI tool mentioned in the chapter is particularly useful for studying and test preparation through personalized flashcards and quizzes?

options.text: Quizlet
Quizlet

questions.question_text: What is one limitation of AI highlighted in the chapter that students should be aware of when using it for schoolwork?

options.text: AI always provides perfectly accurate information
AI cannot process data quickly enough for student needs
AI struggles to understand context fully and may give irrelevant answers
AI can replace teachers and classmates entirelyCorrect Answer: C) AI struggles to understand context fully and may give irrelevant answers

questions.question_text: What is a common myth about AI debunked in the chapter?

options.text: AI is a tool that can assist with specific tasks like studying or writing
AI is too complicated for teens to use without advanced tech skills
AI can be personalized to adapt to a student’s learning pace
AI helps with repetitive tasks to save timeCorrect Answer: B) AI is too complicated for teens to use without advanced tech skills

questions.question_text: How does the chapter suggest students use AI responsibly for school assignments?

options.text: Rely on AI to complete all assignments without personal effort
Use AI as a helper and fact-check its output to ensure accuracy
Avoid using AI tools since they are not allowed in schools
Share personal information with AI tools without checking privacy policiesCorrect Answer: B) Use AI as a helper and fact-check its output to ensure accuracy
